title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL with DFlash and SIRCL on four Sparks
evidence_scope: Four GB10 Sparks, TP4/DCP1, B12X target and draft, BF16 KV, DFlash5, V2 runner; llm-decode-bench v0.6.2 at 8K/128K and C1/C8 with 20-second decode windows. Text serving and bounded performance checks pass on one site. Acceptance varies between runs; these results do not establish a universal decode speedup.
